title: NickHub OP ESP AND AIMBOT WIH WALL CHECK ANTI BAN
features:
NICKHUB: ONE TAP 

 KEY FEATURES
💎 ESP

Body Glow (Highlight): High-fidelity glowing visuals for all enemies. No more messy boxes.
Always On Top: See enemies clearly through walls and obstacles.
Recursive Scan: Automatically detects duplicates or hidden bots that other scripts miss.

🎯 AIMBOT

Target Selector: Switch between Head or Body lock instantly via the menu.
Legit & Rage: Adjustable sensitivity for smooth tracking or instant locking.
FOV Circle: Visual range indicator for your aimbot.
Visibility Check: Smart wall-check to prevent shooting at obstacles.
